In the Toy World, Sun Wuyuan, a piece of stationaries, is pointed out as defective good by others. Offended by their comments, Wuyuan committing to find the Golden Staff to prove that he is the Monkey King. After hearing that the Crossing Hall is the entrance to the West, Sun Wuyuan snuck up into the hall at midnight and began his journey to the West. Wuyuan finds Sun Wukong in Mount Huaguo and is willing to take on the training courses that Wukong offers in exchange for Golden Staff upon completion. But later, after being convinced by the anthropomorphic Bull Demon King, Wuyuan believes that Wukong deceived him. So, he steals the Golden Cudgel while Wukong is napping. After the Bull Demon King took the Golden Staff, Wuyuan flees back to the Toy World yet realizing the world has been conquered by the Bull Demon King. To restore the Toy World while saving Wukong, Wuyuan and his friend, Qiqi, headed back into the West to take down the Bull Demon King. In the end, the Bull Demon King is defeated and Wukong agrees to lend the Golden Staff to Wuyuan for one day

45055:
Self-styled pessimist Tamahiko Shima lives alone in the mountains of Chiba after losing the use of his right hand in the same car accident that took his mother's life. Deemed incapable by his father and other wealthy relatives, he has been forced into exile; he experiences idle days of reading and sleepless nights of irrepressible angst. True to the Shimas' famous pride and determined not to disgrace his family, Tamahiko is resigned to his new duty—stay in the mountains and wait for death to put an end to his suffering.

However, on one snowy night, Tamahiko's insomnia is interrupted by someone knocking at the door. He then meets the 14-year-old Yuzuki Tachibana, who announces that she has come to be his future wife! Suddenly, Tamahiko remembers his father promising to send him a bride to assist him with impediments to his daily life.

Although she was sold as a bride to repay her family's debts, Yuzuki proves to be thoughtful, diligent, and dedicated to Tamahiko. Will the world-weary teenager prove insensitive to the rare breeze of kindness her presence brings to his monotonous existence?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

45069:
The story revolves around the life of the Rod family, who runs a seafood restaurant. Their peaceful life is disrupted by their daughter Rococo's dream of playing football. Although Rococo is exceptionally talented, Rod, haunted by painful memories from his youth, doesn't want her to step onto the football field. Ignoring her father's objections, Rococo, along with her brother and friends, joins the football team, forging a new way of communicating through the sport. However, a hostile rival has also set its sights on their team, putting them in danger.

As the conflict between father and daughter escalates, they gradually realize each other's importance. Through football, they begin to understand each other's feelings and gradually resolve their differences. Ultimately, father and daughter unite, overcome difficulties, and win the match, thwarting the evil forces' plot. This story emphasizes the importance of family relationships, understanding, and unity. Through football, father and daughter are able to reconnect, overcome difficulties together, and realize the daughter's football dream.

(Source: Douban, translated)
45078: In the universe, where all living beings are robots, a Rainbow Planet is home to 7 countries that correspond to each colour of the rainbow. The planet has colourful dome around it protecting it from outside danger. Meanwhile, The Dark Planet controlled by the Black Hole King searches around finding, then feasting on other planets for energy. One day, the Dark Planet stumbles upon the Rainbow Planet, and tries to eat it, but cannot due to its dome, however the 7 countries on the Rainbow Planet are in world war. Unintentionally causing the dome to weaken, and the prince of the Dark Planet, Prince Zebra, knows about this weakness. Thus Prince Zebra taking on the mission to escalate the war quicker by being sent to the Rainbow Planet. Amongst the chaos of war, a young man named Fredo is gifted with powerful abilities, and wants to make peace with the countries. Uniting them against The Dark Planet.

45121:
A cataclysmic natural disaster struck, and the Purple Demon Orchid proliferated rampantly in the human-inhabited valleys. Its poison could corrupt and kill, except for Flower Valley, which was spared thanks to the protection of the Flower God Tree. However, the peace of Flower Valley was shattered when a baby infected with the Purple Demon Orchid's poison, brought by the divine beast Phoenix from outside the valley, was brought in. The King and Queen of Flower Valley defied their ancestral rule of forbidding outsiders, taking in the baby, naming her Princess Peony, and raising her to adulthood. Suddenly, the Flower God Tree withered, and Princess Peony fell seriously ill, causing suspicion among the people of Flower Valley. Many petitioned the King to send Princess Peony away. Unable to sever her maternal bond, the Queen sought help from the Flower God Tree, willingly sacrificing herself to undergo a trial in the Black Barrier to bring back the Flower Soul. However, due to the Purple Demon Orchid's immense power, the Queen was trapped and never returned. Ten years later, Peony grew up, and the Purple Demon Orchid returned, plunging Flower Valley into unprecedented calamity. Princess Peony, remembering the Queen's teachings, embarked on an adventure with the Flower Soul Seed to save Flower Valley.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)

The parallel world is ruled by the evil Queen Mandora, who plots to conquer the human world and enslave humanity, driving a rich and compelling narrative. The characters feature the aesthetics of classical Chinese beauties blended with a modern, fashionable flair; by embracing the popular "China-chic" trend, the series brilliantly showcases unique traditional Chinese culture.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

A baby princess named Ocean is sent away from the North Pole by her mother because of the tyranny of the magma dragon who controls the volcano. The next twelve years, Princess Ocean lives on a local island and encounters a transforming polar bear whom she names Roly Poly. And she talks to a duo of little fish. While encountering the pirates, she meets an inventor named Momo. Their plan is to subdue and defeat the magma dragon.  

(Source: Wikipedia)
45169:
In the beginning of the Spirit Realm, Yin and Yang were undifferentiated, a primordial chaos. Later, the Great Dao sprouted, and spirits were born within it. The spirits created all things in the Spirit Realm and transformed their power into the Nine Sacred Artifacts in the Valley of the Origin God, maintaining the stability of the Spirit Realm and ensuring its perpetual existence. 

The human race of the Spirit Realm—the Torch Emperor—unwittingly discovered the method of cultivating fragments of the Great Dao—Spiritual Qi—and thus became the first ruler of humanity. He discovered the immense power of the Valley of the Origin God and ventured deep within, attempting to wield divine power with a mortal body. However, the Sacred Artifacts were exceptionally powerful and beyond the reach of ordinary humans. The Torch Emperor was ultimately consumed by the powerful spiritual energy. Before his death, the Torch Emperor declared: "He who inherits the Nine Sacred Artifacts will gain eternal life, living as long as heaven and earth." 

Currently, ordinary people can only live in cities protected by sacred artifacts. The Spirit Realm is divided between the Xuan Yang Clan, the Moon Clan, and the Mountain and Sea Alliance, forming a three-way balance of power that barely maintains a facade of peace… Yingyue Liuli, the daughter of the Shadow Moon Clan chief and the heir to the clan, possesses extraordinary talent, and her clan hopes she can lead the Shadow Moon Clan to rise again. However, Liuli only wants to live a simple and easy life, to be a carefree slacker.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
45187:
The story revolves around Zhai Hualong, whose father is a martial arts instructor and grandfather is a traditional Chinese medicine doctor. He learned martial arts from a young age but had never practiced football. Due to his parents' job relocation, he moved from a small town to a big city, where he was ridiculed for being somewhat unsophisticated. His father and grandfather hoped he would pursue martial arts and traditional Chinese medicine, and did not support his pursuit of professional football. 

However, Zhai Hualong fell in love with football, yearned to become a professional player, and longed for recognition from his classmates in the big city. He joined an elite school football team, utilizing his childhood martial arts training to perfectly integrate football with Chinese martial arts, and also gained a deeper understanding of global football. Through each match, he also taught young viewers the importance of perseverance, teamwork, and a spirit of not fearing difficulties.

(Source: Youku, translated)
45195:
In order to find the missing friend Xiao Yuan, the protagonist, Jiang Yao, sneaked into an abandoned villa to investigate, but was caught by a mysterious black shadow by accident and almost doomed. However, this was only the beginning of his bad luck. Behind the chain of events, Jiang Yao gradually realized that he was following him as a person who "shouldn't exist". The shadowy crisis, the truth about the disappearance of his friends, the hidden organization of the dark world... Behind the bizarre incident, a conspiracy that spans a thousand years has quietly awakened, and the battle between righteous and evil is about to begin. The animation incorporates suspense, adventure, inspiration and other elements, presenting the audience a struggle story of self-improvement and positive energy.

45425:
Since childhood, Hiyori Yamakawa has witnessed her father's various eccentricities, but one activity she has always loved doing with him is fly fishing—a complicated yet rewarding method of catching fish. Even after his sudden death, Hiyori still visits the seaside in her spare time, savoring the joy that her father's memento brings her.

Three years later, Hiyori's mother decides to remarry and arranges a dinner with her fiancé, his daughter, and Hiyori to celebrate. Anxious and wanting to pass the time, Hiyori goes to her usual fishing spot when a rather energetic girl named Koharu Minagi suddenly appears before her. The two soon become acquainted, with Koharu taking an interest in fly fishing herself. However, their meeting is more than just a coincidence: Koharu turns out to be Hiyori's future stepsibling, which is only the beginning of treasured memories the both of them will reel in as they foster their sisterhood.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

This planet has been occupied by the DS (Damocles) technological army, led by a powerful AI (artificial intelligence system). The Falcon Force, resisting the AI ​​and DS, is purging Mad Dog Town (a DS testing ground). Ma San, a former electrician in Mad Dog Town who possesses deja vu (briefly predicting the future), along with the mysterious woman Luo Ning, the cyborg Ling, and the hacker Xiao Hai, rebel and escape. The owner of Mad Dog Town ("Father" Moby) escapes the colony in a rocket, and the townspeople are about to be burned alive. To save them, Ma San connects to the AI's Sky Eye satellite, successfully stopping the Father and escaping Mad Dog Town with the others. This action suggests that Ma San might be from DS, and he begins to doubt the origin of his deja vu. The group arrives at an abandoned post-apocalyptic refugee camp. The leader, Feng Zi'ang, recognizes Ma San, calling him "Commander," and volunteers to help him regain his memories. Little does he know, this is merely the prelude to a conspiracy…
